resources.string: No MAVLink heartbeat. Check the phone Wi-Fi, the aircraft address under Tools, and close other clients using UDP 14550.
Use 192.168.4.1 for the direct hotspot. In router STA mode, enter the aircraft IPv4 address printed by the serial wifi command.
Change the aircraft address only while disarmed

The top-left label is the current standby mode; Position takeoff always performs pre-arm, arms, and hands over to Position. Bottom-left or the button emergency-disarms. Backgrounding invokes FCU link-loss protection.
FCU is disconnected or physical RC has priority
ToF/READY telemetry is not ready yet. Position takeoff may still be sent; the FCU performs the current pre-arm checks, arms automatically, and explicitly rejects an invalid command.

1. Choose one network. For the direct open32drone hotspot, use aircraft address 192.168.4.1. In router STA mode, join the same router and enter the DHCP address printed by the serial wifi command under Tools > Aircraft address. Close other ground controllers.
2. Keep the aircraft level and still until MAVLink connects. READY/ToF are diagnostic only; a missing numeric ToF range is normal in the near-floor blind zone.
3. The top-left label is the current standby mode; do not select a mode or arm separately. Set a height and hold Position takeoff; the FCU performs the current pre-arm checks, arms, climbs, and always hands over to Position.
4. Automatic takeoff and landing own vertical motion only. Both sticks become available as soon as the FCU accepts the command, so roll, pitch, and yaw remain correctable.
5. Land is always available while connected and supersedes an unfinished takeoff. Pull the left stick fully down to abort takeoff; push it above center to cancel landing.
6. For emergencies, hold Emergency stop or hold the left stick bottom-left for 0.2 s. Valid physical SBUS pilot activity takes priority and disables phone sticks.
7. First remove propellers and verify the link, Position-takeoff command, landing, emergency stop, and link-loss behavior before flight.
Physical RC activity detected: SBUS has priority and phone sticks are disabled.
Automatic takeoff: both sticks can correct attitude/direction now; pull fully down to abort.
Automatic landing: both sticks still correct attitude/direction; push up to cancel.
Non-takeoff/landing automatic control is active. Phone sticks are locked to avoid conflicting with the external controller; emergency stop remains available.
Update requires a connected, landed, disarmed aircraft
Select the matching app .bin only, never merged.bin. The first A/B migration requires a complete USB flash. Remove propellers and close other controllers.
